import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def min_text_length_after_abbreviation(n, words):
    # Create a dictionary to store the start indices of each word
    word_indices = defaultdict(list)
    for i, word in enumerate(words):
        word_indices[word].append(i)
    
    # Function to calculate the length of the text after abbreviation
    def calculate_length(start1, end1, start2, end2):
        # Calculate the length of the abbreviated text
        len1 = len(words[start1])
        len2 = len(words[start2])
        return (end1 - start1 + 1) * len1 + (end2 - start2 + 1) * len2
    
    # Initialize the minimum length to the original length of the text
    min_length = sum(len(word) for word in words) + n - 1
    
    # Iterate over all pairs of equal segments
    for word, indices in word_indices.items():
        if len(indices) < 2:
            continue
        for i in range(len(indices)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(indices)):
                start1, end1 = indices[i], indices[i] + len(indices) - 1
                start2, end2 = indices[j], indices[j] + len(indices) - 1
                # Check if the segments are non-intersecting
                if end1 < start2 or end2 < start1:
                    # Calculate the new length after abbreviation
                    new_length = calculate_length(start1, end1, start2, end2)
                    # Update the minimum length
                    min_length = min(min_length, new_length)
    
    return min_length
